name: Omavet
author: vonsensey
description: Local security review for installed plugins: a deterministic capability scan (network, process, file writes, filesystem reach, obfuscation), per-plugin trust dials, and a review gate for plugin updates. Never phones home.

barWidget.description: Shield tinted by the worst trust score across installed plugins, with a badge when a plugin update is pending review. Click for per-plugin report cards.
